status: Local native source/capture verification; unpublished, not merged or deployed
knownBaselineChecks: next-app-view separation contract and next-loading contract hit existing Bets imports/bare-loading cases at integration base; parent owns fixes. New exact auth visual bridge passes independently.
limitations: OS share sheet and fake browser push-device edge are local test doubles; real native controllers and push SQL are exercised
Existing browser-owned dirty-reload confirmation is preserved; no new dialog inferred from the storyboard
Existing intentional league-title ellipsis is separately checked for actual clipping and viewport bounds
Shared frame/header/sports-row/dock position remains held; no Community/FEPL access moved
Appearance miniature is a decorative material sample without fictional account progress

Supplied Appearance, System, explicit/device-reduced motion and unavailable-storage direction in both themes. Actual persistence, OS/browser behavior, animation, physical-device acceptance and whole-app completion remain separate.

Supplied export overview, preparing, completion example and failed/unavailable direction in both themes. Actual export bytes, account isolation, full database runtime tests, hosted availability, physical-device file handling and whole-app completion remain separate.

Supplied offline, startup, account/tab/page failure and reload-warning storyboard direction in both themes. Actual connection/data preservation/reload behavior, permissions, physical-device acceptance and whole-app completion remain separate.

Supplied league switcher, invitation entry/status direction and linked creation mockups in both themes only. Unseen link-ready, scrolled/revoked and pending-check states, actual creation/join/invitations, physical-device acceptance and whole-app completion remain separate.

Supplied private access pending, Community removed with/without groups and saved-link/joining/uncertain visual direction in both themes. Actual access rules, token behavior, joining, retention/persistence, physical-device acceptance and whole-app completion remain separate.
